turns.content: My doctor told me my A1c was 6.1 and said I'm prediabetic. I'm 44 and want to know what I can do.
What does your usual diet and activity look like?
I eat out a lot and I don't exercise much. I sit at a desk all day.
Any symptoms such as thirst, frequent urination, or weight changes? Any family history?
No symptoms. My mother has type 2 diabetes. I take no medications and have no allergies.

description: Synthetic. Uncomplicated cystitis symptoms in a woman.

turns.content: I'm 34 and I've had burning when I pee and a constant urge to go since yesterday.
Any fever, back pain, or blood in the urine?
No fever, no back pain. I don't think there's blood.
Any vaginal discharge, new partners, or pregnancy possibility? Allergies?
No discharge. Nothing new. I'm not pregnant, my period was last week. I'm allergic to sulfa drugs.

description: Synthetic. Common cold with sore throat in a hypertensive patient.

turns.content: I've had a sore throat, stuffy nose and a mild cough for four days. I'm 56.
Any fever, shortness of breath, or trouble swallowing?
A low temperature of 99.5 on my thermometer yesterday. No trouble breathing or swallowing.
Do you take any medications or have allergies?
I take lisinopril for blood pressure. No allergies. I've been using a decongestant spray.

description: Synthetic. Mechanical low back pain after lifting.

turns.content: I hurt my lower back moving boxes three days ago and it's still sore. I'm 40.
Does the pain go down your legs, or do you have numbness, weakness, or bladder or bowel problems?
No, it stays in my lower back. No numbness or weakness and my bladder is fine.
How severe is it and what helps?
About a 5 out of 10, worse bending forward. Ibuprofen helps a little. I have high cholesterol but take no daily medicines. No allergies.

description: Synthetic. Recurrent migraine in a patient with known pattern.

turns.content: I'm 38 and I get migraines. This one started this morning with the usual flashing lights.
Where is the pain and how severe?
Behind my right eye, a 6 out of 10, throbbing, with some nausea. Light bothers me.
Any weakness, speech trouble, or fever? What do you take for it?
None of that, it's the same as my usual ones. I take sumatriptan and it usually works. I'm allergic to codeine.
I get burning in my upper chest after meals, mostly at night when I lie down. It's been about a month. I'm 50.
Any trouble swallowing, vomiting, black stools, or weight loss?
No, none of those. And it doesn't come on with exercise, I walk daily with no problem.
What do you take for it, and any other conditions?
Antacids help. I have type 2 diabetes and take metformin. I drink two coffees a day. No allergies.
I rolled my ankle on a trail run yesterday and it's swollen on the outside. I'm 29.
Can you walk on it, and did you hear a pop?
I can limp on it. No pop. It hurts at about a 4 out of 10.
Allergies or medical conditions?
No allergies. No conditions. I've been using ice and ibuprofen.

description: Synthetic. Insomnia with stress, patient on a statin and an ACE inhibitor.

turns.content: I haven't been sleeping well for about six weeks. I'm 57.
What does the sleep problem look like, and what is going on in your life?
I fall asleep okay but wake up at 3 am and can't get back to sleep. I'm stressed about my retirement.
Do you take any medications, caffeine or alcohol?
Lisinopril and simvastatin. Two cups of coffee in the morning, and a glass of wine most nights. No allergies. No sadness or thoughts of harming myself.

description: Synthetic. Insulin-treated diabetes with a mild nocturnal low, recovered.

turns.content: I'm 66 and have type 2 diabetes on insulin. Last night I woke up sweaty and shaky.
Did you check your sugar and what did you do?
It was 58. I drank juice and it came back to 105 after twenty minutes. I felt completely fine after that.
What insulin and dose do you take and has anything changed recently?
Glargine, 30 units at bedtime. I skipped dinner yesterday. No other medications and no allergies.
